current_manuscript: v9; numerical results unchanged from the complete v7 MA27 rerun

directories.experiments/inputs: All twelve benchmark inputs and timed Hybrid A* references, JSON and MATLAB MAT formats.
directories.experiments/source/CommonParking: Benchmark and initialization source snapshot with upstream license notices.
directories.experiments/revision_v7: Current source, parameters, result summaries, numerical checks and figure generators.
directories.experiments/revision_v7/results: Every successful or failed solver return, initial guess, settings and dense interpolation arrays.
directories.experiments/revision_v7/logs: Complete IPOPT logs for all 217 current attempts.
directories.experiments/revision_v7/refinement: Per-case sequences and cumulative costs of all refinement attempts.
directories.experiments/revision_v7/catalog: Stage-specific links from each attempt to its input, output, log and dense collision data.
directories.experiments/revision_v5: Historical MUMPS study, including diagnostic model variants; superseded by the MA27 rerun.
directories.experiments/revision_v6: Historical geometry/proof checks and figure source; no new NLP runs.
directories.manuscript/tables: Generated current result tables and historical tables needed by retained checks.

linear_solver_library: Supply an HSL library through BME_HSL_LIBRARY. HSL binaries are external dependencies, not redistributed.
timing: One retained timed run per configuration. Rerun wall times can differ. Current main comparison beta=0.6 remains prespecified.
placement: BME uniform initialization uses the same automatically estimated count and free interval durations as adaptive initialization.
data_policy: Successful and unsuccessful returns retained; any included historical variants are explicitly separated from current manuscript results.
